title: Why Wasoko's Founder Chose a Merger of Equals With Egypt's MaxAB
conflicts: Founding year given as 2013, 2014, 2015 and (Yu himself) a 2016 Kenya launch; the story names no founding year. notes: Episode is the December 2023 to August 2024 merger, with the SMS kiosk model and the Relief Watch health-clinic pivot as one paragraph of background; Yu's September 2025 step-back is the aftermath.
